title: Prohibition of Endorsement by Central Authority

content.scenario: A famous Indian cricketer endorses a health supplement that is later found to be misleading. The Central Authority investigates and finds that this is the cricketer's second offense within a year.
content.outcome: The Central Authority may prohibit the cricketer from making any endorsement of any product or service for a period of up to three years due to subsequent contravention.

user_queries: What happens if a celebrity endorses a false product?
Can the Central Authority ban endorsements?
How long can an endorser be prohibited from making endorsements?
